messages.subject: Re: Simplest way to change between tab panels on a timer?
parts:
Here you go. All that I have done is added a snippet I found on SO http://stackoverflow.com/questions/11978977/change-twitter-bootstrap-tabs-automatically, that automatically cycles through bootstrap tabs. To keep the code clean, you might want to throw the javascript into an external js file, in which case you can add it using tags$script(src = 'path/to/ext.js').

require(shiny)
runApp(list(
  ui = pageWithSidebar(
    headerPanel("Tab Carousel"),
    sidebarPanel(),
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(id = 'mytab',
        tabPanel("Plot", plotOutput("plot")),
        tabPanel("Summary", verbatimTextOutput("summary")),
        tabPanel("Table", tableOutput("table"))
      ),
      tags$script(HTML("var tabCarousel = setInterval(function() {
         var tabs = $('#mytab li'),
          active = tabs.filter('.active'),
          next = active.next('li'),
          toClick = next.length ? next.find('a') : tabs.eq(0).find('a');
          toClick.trigger('click');
      }, 3000);"))
    )
  ),
  server = function(input, output){
  }
))
